Name: (AT) Brighterbats Pretty Pride Flags
Author: circecil
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿Hey y'all! Here's the long awaited 2.0 update for the pride flags!!!
I've added 17 more flags, hopefully i've covered a wide array.
I'm thinking of creating a seperate pack with xenogenders and more fringe identities, so tell me if you'd like to see that!

New in the 2.0 update, the flags can now be found in the Miners Crest item AND the Burnt Offering item, this way it's hopefully easier to find ingame.

If you have suggestions for flags to add in a future update, please let me know! I plan to update this periodically with new flags as time goes on. :]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/1JjXGpj/preview.png[/img]﻿

[/center]
